Results.ReviewText:
I’ve owned a great number of grills over the years and always went with a less expensive, less quality product figuring “how much difference can there be in a gas grill!?”
Well. 
Now I know. 
Weber makes an amazing product. 
The burner somehow creates a more even heating and the cooking process is superior. 
There is a difference in gas grills and the grilling experience.

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
I have a Spirit grill in another house which was purchased in 2016.    This grill has four wheels Which are all the locking small wheels.   It makes a big difference.   I was disappointed with the newest Spirit grill as there are only two wheels on one side and ‘skids’ on the other side.    This has completely limited the mobility of this product.   Unfortunately it was a gift and I can’t do anything about this.   I have almost daily moved my Spirit in and out of our garage to use it.   It is now more difficult to accomplish this, and every time I do I regret having this product,    Unfortunately even if additional wheels were an option, there are no holes in the legs to accommodate an axle.    If at least there were holes for receiving an optional axle a customer could purchase these items and installed them himself.

Thank youkk
Results.Title: Where did the wheels go?

44010001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
